claim: The js admin-ui/account-ui bundles are consumed by i18next ({{n}} interpolation), so changing error-invalid-multivalued-size to MessageFormat '{0} ... {2,choice,...}' makes the consoles display the raw template instead of substituted values.
body:
## [ISSUE] i18next placeholders replaced with Java MessageFormat syntax, so the admin and account consoles show the raw template

**Severity:** HIGH - user-visible regression in the React admin and account consoles: the multivalued-size validation error shows literal `{0} ... {2,choice,...}` text.

### The Problem
`js/apps/admin-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v2/admin/messages/messages_en.properties:3138` (the same change is in `js/apps/account-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v3/account/messages/messages_en.properties:188`):

```properties
-error-invalid-multivalued-size=Attribute {{0}} must have at least {{1}} and at most {{2}} value(s).
+error-invalid-multivalued-size=Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}.
```

The value was copied from the FreeMarker/`MessageFormat` bundles (`themes/.../base/login/messages/messages_en.properties`). The React UIs do not use `MessageFormat`.

### Theory / Proof
- `js/apps/admin-ui/src/i18n/i18n.ts` sets up **i18next** with the default interpolation settings (`{{` / `}}`). Messages come from `ThemeResource.getLocalizationTexts` (`services/.../ThemeResource.java:119-156`), which returns the raw property values without converting them.
- `js/libs/ui-shared/src/user-profile/utils.ts:74-85` calls `t(errorMessage, {...params})` with the positional params `0`, `1`, `2`. i18next substitutes only `{{0}}`, `{{1}}`, `{{2}}`, so `{0}` stays as literal text. i18next has no ICU `choice` support unless you add `i18next-icu`, which is not installed. The `{2,choice,...}` clause is therefore printed verbatim.
- Every other parameterised key in the admin-ui bundle uses `{{n}}` (25 lines, for example `error-empty=Please specify value of '{{0}}'.`). This key is now the only exception.

### What happens today vs. what will break
Before: "Attribute email must have at least 1 and at most 3 value(s)."
After: "Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}." This appears in the admin console user form and the account console whenever the `multivalued` validator fails.

### Research
The i18next docs (https://www.i18next.com/translation-function/interpolation) give `{{value}}` as the default delimiters. ICU/`choice` syntax needs the `i18next-icu` plugin. Plurals use the `_one` / `_other` key suffixes.

### Recommendation
Revert the two js bundles to i18next syntax. The verifier's special case for this key in `normalizeValue` only matters for the `MessageFormat` bundles.

```properties
error-invalid-multivalued-size=Attribute {{0}} must have at least {{1}} and at most {{2}} value(s).
```

For proper pluralisation in i18next, add `error-invalid-multivalued-size_one` / `_other` keys that use `{{count}}`, and do not reuse MessageFormat choice syntax.

claim: The replacement totpStep1/loginTotpStep1 strings for Lithuanian (account and login) are Italian text, and the account zh_CN totpStep1 is written in Traditional Chinese characters.
body:
## [ISSUE] Replacement TOTP strings are in the wrong language: Lithuanian gets Italian, Simplified Chinese gets Traditional Chinese

**Severity:** MEDIUM - users of the lt and zh_CN locales see a foreign-language or wrong-script instruction on the OTP setup page.

### The Problem
To remove the `<a href=...>` links, the PR replaced `totpStep1` / `loginTotpStep1` with new text copied from other locales. Two of the copies came from the wrong locale:

- `themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/account/messages/messages_lt.properties:101`
  `totpStep1=Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:` (Italian)
- `themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/login/messages/messages_lt.properties:71`
  `loginTotpStep1=Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:` (Italian)
- `themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/account/messages/messages_zh_CN.properties:112`
  `totpStep1=在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：` (Traditional script: 手機 / 應用程式 / 安裝. Simplified would be 手机 / 应用程序 / 安装)

The original Lithuanian text started "Įdiekite ...". The sibling `login/messages_zh_CN.properties:123` correctly uses Simplified: `在您的移动设备中安装以下任意一个应用：`.

### Theory / Proof
The Italian bundle has `totpStep1=Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo dispositivo mobile`, which is almost the same text. zh_CN is the Simplified Chinese locale, but Traditional characters are used here, which zh_TW users would expect.

### What happens today vs. what will break
Before this PR, Lithuanian users saw a Lithuanian sentence, although it had outdated links. After this PR, they see Italian. zh_CN account-console users see Traditional characters mixed with a Simplified UI.

### Research
Since these are community translations, the usual practice is to drop the key so it falls back to English, rather than put in text from another language.

### Recommendation
Remove the keys so they fall back to the English source, or use a proper translation:

```properties
# account/messages_lt.properties and login/messages_lt.properties
totpStep1=Įdiekite vieną iš šių programėlių savo mobiliajame telefone:
loginTotpStep1=Įdiekite vieną iš šių programėlių savo mobiliajame telefone:
# account/messages_zh_CN.properties
totpStep1=在您的手机上安装以下应用程序之一：
```

claim: The 'Didn't find anchor tag' validation message omits both the key and the file, so the aggregated Mojo failure cannot be traced to a bundle.
body:
## [ISSUE] "Didn't find anchor tag" error names neither the key nor the file

**Severity:** LOW - build failures are hard to act on: with about 160 bundles checked in one Mojo run, the error does not say where the bad anchor is.

### The Problem
`VerifyMessageProperties.java:157`:
```java
messages.add("Didn't find anchor tag " + matcher.group() + " in original string");
```
`santizeAnchors` receives `key` but never uses it, and `file` is not included. `ThemeVerifierMojo.execute()` collects messages from every `messages_*.properties` file under every resource dir and throws one `MojoFailureException("Validation errors: " + messages)`. The anchor error is the only message with no location. The duplicate-key message includes `file.getAbsolutePath()`, and the illegal-HTML message includes `key` and `file`.

### Theory / Proof
An anchor mismatch usually also leaves the anchor in `value`, so an "Illegal HTML" message may appear too. It does not when the English value has no HTML, because the anchor is then stripped by `POLICY_NO_HTML`. It also does not when the mismatch comes from the English side running out of anchors on a closing tag. Either way, the anchor line itself cannot be traced.

### What happens today vs. what will break
A translator who changes a link target gets `Validation errors: [Didn't find anchor tag <a href="..."> in original string]` and has to grep 160 files for it.

### Research
The other two checks in this class already use the "in key X for file Y" format.

### Recommendation
```java
messages.add("Didn't find anchor tag " + matcher.group() + " in original string for key " + key + " in file " + file);
```

claim: If the English bundle derived by path rewriting does not exist, verifySafeHtml throws an unchecked RuntimeException that aborts the Mojo instead of adding a validation message.
